<!-- Generated by esquadro docs from the blueprint's manifest: do not edit. -->

Errors in the client's language: each request is answered in the language its Accept-Language prefers among the ones below (in Content-Language), and the title of every problem is translated; the code stays the same. esquadro knows pt-BR and es; translations.go, yours, adds or changes titles.

```esquadro
blueprint i18n
```

## Works with

- **Requires** [http](../http/): the app must use them too.

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `languages` | list | `["en"]` | Languages of the answers, the first being the default. |

```esquadro
blueprint i18n {
  languages ["en"]
}
```
